Rekindling the Verdant Years Chapter 129: The Cooking Auntie Doesn't Have to Cook Again

Since agreeing to help Ying Chanxi film the MV, Li Luo discovered a rather tricky problem.

It wasn't that he minded Ying Chanxi always dragging him to various places around school to record videos, but that after recording, Ying Chanxi still needed to upload these videos to a computer.

And then use the computer to do the editing work.

And so... Li Luo hadn't been able to write properly for several nights.

"Are you still editing today?"

Watching Ying Chanxi, who had just finished her shower and was wearing a set of pajamas, knock and enter his bedroom, Li Luo closed his writing software, sighed, and asked.

"Mm... Is it inconvenient?" Ying Chanxi walked over to the computer and glanced at it. "What are you doing?"

"...Playing games." Li Luo's lips twitched as he obediently gave her his seat. "You can edit your video then."

After speaking, Li Luo took out the hair dryer, had Ying Chanxi sit down and focus on her MV, and turned it on to help her dry her hair.

Enjoying Li Luo's service, Ying Chanxi squinted her eyes comfortably and began operating the editing software, starting to process the recorded footage according to the ideas in her mind.

Because she had only just started trying to edit videos, she wasn't very skilled with the software, so her progress was slow.

At this current speed, combined with her habit of re-recording some footage every couple of days, Li Luo highly doubted that the MV for this song could be finished within the year.

If this affected his writing efficiency, it would be a bit of a disaster.

After all, for the song "Waiting For You After Class," although Yan Zhusheng had previously said she would recommend it to her mother's company, it seemed for now that it hadn't been picked.

So all the effort being put into this song right now was purely a passion project.

It was definitely not as important as the book he was working on, "I'm Really Not a Star."

When his royalties were paid out on the 12th and deposited into his bank account, his savings would officially break the one hundred thousand yuan mark.

For a reincarnator, this amount of money was frankly a bit embarrassing to mention.

But he was still just a first-year high school student, and he didn't even know what to do with this money in his hands.

If possible, he quite wanted to buy a storefront on the street west of Qianjiang University.

When the subway line opened and the Longhu Times Tianjie was built, the prices of the shops there would shoot up day by day.

At that time, the surrounding housing prices had once broken twenty-five thousand yuan per square meter, not to mention the nearby shops, which sold for thirty to forty thousand per square meter.

Those in better locations could even be speculated to prices over fifty thousand.

Even later, when housing prices began to fall, the shop prices around Longhu Times Tianjie remained above thirty thousand, thanks to the student economy driven by Qianjiang University.

If he could buy a storefront there before the news of the subway and Longhu Times Tianjie construction got out, it would be a completely surefire profitable venture.

Unfortunately, Li Luo only had one hundred thousand yuan on hand right now.

And even if he had the money, as a minor, he couldn't buy property on his own. He would still have to find a way to persuade his parents.

These were all troublesome issues.

Fortunately, he had successfully secured the apartment in Bihuai Lanting, so Li Luo decided not to think about it so much for the time being.

A person had to know when to be content.

"What are you thinking about?!"

Ying Chanxi's delicate foot, still damp with water droplets, kicked the top of Li Luo's foot as she snapped at him, "The hair dryer is burning me!"

"Oh, oh, sorry, sorry, I was distracted." Li Luo quickly moved the hair dryer away, only to realize that Ying Chanxi's hair was already dry.

"You're not trying to get back at me for taking your computer, are you?" Ying Chanxi narrowed her eyes suspiciously. "Is gaming really that addictive?"

"Not at all." Li Luo shook his head repeatedly. "I was captivated by your superb editing skills. I was watching you create the MV the whole time, completely mesmerized."

"You're always talking nonsense." Ying Chanxi rolled her eyes at him, but the way her fair-skinned feet curled up under the desk slightly betrayed her inner thoughts.

After lingering in Li Luo's bedroom until ten o'clock at night, Ying Chanxi reluctantly turned off the computer and said to Li Luo, who was lying on the bed looking at his phone, "I'm going back to my room. You should sleep early too."

"Yeah, got it."

Ying Chanxi walked out of Li Luo's room, then poked her head back in from the doorway. "Goodnight."

"Goodnight."

Nodding with satisfaction, Ying Chanxi closed Li Luo's bedroom door and returned to her own room.

Lying on her bed, she hugged the Pikachu on her headboard and, following her recent daily bedtime routine, gently bopped Pikachu's head a few times.

Then she patted it a few times to comfort it. Ying Chanxi placed Pikachu back on the headboard, turned over to hug her panda doll, and drifted into a sweet sleep.

On Saturday morning, during the last self-study period, Li Luo gathered the whole class and had Zhu Yufei lead them in a practice drill for their formation for the sports meet's opening ceremony entrance.

"Class Eight, Class Eight, unstoppable might, spirits soaring, kings of the fight!"

Fortunately, the effects of the military training hadn't been completely forgotten, and the formation march looked quite decent.

Although the slogan seemed a bit cringe-worthy to Li Luo, after looking at the slogans and introductions submitted by other classes the day before, he could only say they were all about the same, so he didn't mind so much.

In any case, during the opening ceremony, he had to leave the formation early to prepare as a member of the rock band, so he wouldn't have to shout this in the line anyway.

After the practice ended and everyone returned to the classroom, the bell for the end of school rang.

After packing her schoolbag, Yan Zhusheng looked at Li Luo with bright, shining eyes.

"Why are you staring at me like that?" Li Luo felt a bit uncomfortable under her gaze and asked as he slung his bag over his shoulder, "Didn't the club president say yesterday that Xie Shuchen has to attend the math club's competition training this afternoon? So we're gathering to practice tomorrow afternoon instead. There's nothing else today, right?"

Yan Zhusheng nodded, then said, "But I already told the cooking auntie that she doesn't need to come to my house to cook today."

"...You're really getting addicted to mooching meals, huh?" Li Luo's lips twitched. "You've already paid for the cooking auntie, isn't this a waste?"

"It's okay, it's pay-per-session. The cooking auntie has other clients too," Yan Zhusheng shook her head and, after explaining, continued to look at him with that innocent expression.

Like a small dog on the roadside, quietly watching the hot dog in his hand. It clearly wants it, but just squats there watching, looking perfectly behaved.

Only when you take the initiative to offer it the hot dog will it obediently open its mouth to enjoy the delicious treat.

"Alright, alright, come eat at my place for lunch." Li Luo walked out of the classroom with his bag, waving for Yan Zhusheng to follow.

"Aren't we waiting for Xixi?" Yan Zhusheng trotted to Li Luo's side and reminded him with a tilt of her head.

"She has to go to the math competition training this afternoon. She won't be back until evening."

"What about our senior?"

"Our senior is busy with sports meet matters. She has to stay at school this afternoon too."

"Oh, I see."

(End of Chapter)
